semantics.intent: Show the Zephyr editor with an AI agent panel executing file reads and searches

visual.style: Light themed code editor UI with a warm beige/off-white background
notes: The right AI panel has a light beige background with subtle bands for execution steps.
The 'Selesai dalam 4s' band appears as a filled grey/beige box behind the text.
The 'Read 2 files, Searched files 1 time' band and its sub-rows appear to have filled grey/beige boxes behind them.
The 'Split With Browser' option in the bottom panel has a filled grey/beige box behind it.

uncertainty: Some text in the file explorer tree is truncated or too small to read confidently.
The exact pixel boundaries of the filled boxes in the AI panel are ambiguous.
